intro.text: A six-legged Rosharan animal kept by humans as a pet, hunting animal and fighting beast.

description.text: Breeds vary widely, from waist-high to small enough to hide in underbrush, the smaller ones very fast. Purelake axehounds differ so much from Alethi ones that they count as a separate species.
Axehounds are six-legged, with a smooth hide between skin and carapace made of interlocking sections, a fluted fish-like tail, and feathery antennae they use to communicate. Their blood is violet.
Axehound fights, with betting, are popular in some places, such as the Middlefest Fair in Jah Keved; axehounds also join organised hunts.
They "trump" with two overlapping voices, humming when content and bellowing in anger or pain, and signal with their antennae.
Young axehounds are energetic and playful, chasing thrown balls, nipping and licking people. They grow closely attached to their owners and learn familiar voices.
